name: Maharashtra Transport (RTO) Services
description: Maharashtra State Transport Department services for DL, RC, permits via state RTOs (integrated with Parivahan).
eligibility: Maharashtra residents / vehicle owners / licence applicants.
benefits: State-specific DL/RC, permits, tax, and faceless services.
application_steps: Book RTO slot; visit for test.
fees: As per Maharashtra MV fee schedule.

faq.q: Are Maharashtra RTO services on Parivahan?
faq.a: Yes, DL/RC services use the national Parivahan/Sarathi platform with state integration.

ai_summary: Maharashtra Transport Department provides DL/RC/permit services via state RTOs integrated with Parivahan.
